newsitem.title: USA: Ex-Astra USA CEO released on bail.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Astra USA CEO released on bail.

text.p: Lars Bildman, ex-chief executive of Astra Ab affiliate Astra USA Inc, who has been charged with 35 counts of fraud and tax evasion, was released on bail of $1.6 million and ordered to stay in his Boston apartment, the court ruled Wednesday.
U.S. District Court Judge Charles Swartwood ordered Bildman to wear a security bracelet at all times and not leave his apartment except for emergencies or court-related appearances.
Bildman's bail included $300,000 backed by his home in the Boston suburb of Brookline and $1.3 million secured by his retirement assets.
Bildman's lawyers had sought permission to allow him to stay at his "Viking's Retreat" ski home in Killington, Vt., but Swartwood asked them last month to find a residence in Massachusetts.
Bildman was fired from his job at the U.S. unit of Swedish pharmaceutical giant Astra Ab last year following reports of widespread sexual harassment at the company.
Bildman, who allegedly defrauded Astra USA of more than $1 million, has pleaded not guilty to the 35 counts of fraud and tax evasion.
A trial date has been set for June 23.
